Cultiway.Construction.Name: Spell name
Cultiway.Construction.BodyHint: This spell exerts force through the actual body. Edit its poses in Body and exertion.
Cultiway.Construction.CopyHint: Teach the chosen learner a separate copy, preserving existing spells and necessary cooldown.
Cultiway.Construction.ReplaceHint: Replace only this learner’s version. Other holders and active casts retain the original.
Cultiway.Construction.Unsaved: The draft has unsaved changes. Discard them or continue editing.
Cultiway.Construction.FinishDraft: Finish the current unsaved draft first.
Cultiway.Construction.Applied: The new revision has been saved and learned.
Cultiway.Construction.AddPathHint: Create an editable flight path from the source or actual attachment. Attached parts detach at launch.
Cultiway.Construction.LocalHint: X, Y and Z follow the part’s local axes at launch, in map tiles.
Cultiway.Construction.TargetLineHint: X is progress from launch to the captured target (0 to 1); Y is sideways tiles and Z is height offset.
Cultiway.Construction.AddPointHint: Append a point 0.25 seconds after the endpoint, then edit its position and handles.
Cultiway.Construction.TooLate: Less than 0.001 seconds remain after launch. Adjust the launch time first.
Cultiway.Construction.NumberRequired: Enter a finite number. The previous value has been kept.
Cultiway.Construction.WorldConstructions: New spell / constructions in this world
Cultiway.Construction.LegacyDraft: Create from an existing base spell
Cultiway.Construction.NoBodyHint: This spell has no body action. Unadapted limbs cannot be added as if they existed.
Cultiway.Construction.UnsupportedEffecto: This part needs a matching body binding
Cultiway.Construction.ProjectBodyHint: Keep exertion and recovery, adding a detached form, tracking and contact. Defaults to 4 spiritual energy; adjust in properties.
Cultiway.Construction.ManifestationHint: Edit matter and size in properties, launch in motion. Body and manifestation share their contact group.
Cultiway.Construction.BodyCoordinatesHin: X is forward, Y sideways and Z height, scaled by actual body height. The last value is torso turn.
Cultiway.Construction.RotationHint: X, Y and Z are local effector rotation angles. The last value is torso turn.
Cultiway.Construction.AddPoseHint: Append a pose 0.1 seconds after the last, preserving position and rotation and extending duration as needed.
Cultiway.Construction.SelectionRangeHint: Range only controls target admission. Hits still follow actual forms and poses; review after changing delivery.
Cultiway.Construction.PlacementRulesHint: Attachment changes placement; release or flight ends following. Effect timing, repeats and material keep their existing rules.
Cultiway.Construction.MakeFollowHint: Remove root release and flight; preserve internal animation, effects and cost.
Cultiway.Construction.MakeOrbitHint: Create a 3-tile orbit with a 4-second period. Select the child to edit radius, or the pivot to edit angular speed.
Cultiway.Construction.ResizeConstruction: Resize generated geometry and contacts; preserve the actual body and per-contact power.
Cultiway.Construction.HasteConstructionH: Scale motion, homing and path speed together; shorten the full timeline of body-only actions.
Cultiway.Construction.DurationConstructi: Stretch the complete timeline with matching poses and paths; keep contact frequency and limits.
Cultiway.Construction.RepeatConstruction: Total copies, lateral spacing, spawn interval. Perform the body action once; multiply total cost by copies.
Cultiway.Construction.IntegerCountRequir: Total copies must be an integer from 1 to 64
Cultiway.Construction.MagnitudeRulesHint: Apply once to this draft; undo is available. Size, speed and duration keep the stated cost. Presence windows gate both visuals and contacts.
